title: Convert Word, Excel and PowerPoint Files Online — No Software Needed
description: Stop installing bloated office suites just to convert a file. FileTools handles DOCX, XLSX and PPTX conversions right in your browser.
excerpt: You got a .docx but need a PDF. Classic. Here's the fastest way to handle it.
content:
## The Problem Everyone Ignores

Someone sends you a Word file. You don't have Word. Or you have Word but need a PDF for a client. Or your teammate exported a spreadsheet as .xlsx and your tool only reads .csv.

This happens daily. Most people either install a full office suite or upload files to sketchy conversion sites plastered with ads.

There's a better option.

## How [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) Handles Documents

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) converts between office formats directly in your browser. DOCX to PDF. XLSX to CSV. PPTX to PDF. No signup. No installation. No file size games.

The conversion runs locally where possible, which means your quarterly report doesn't end up on someone else's server. That matters.

## What Formats Are Supported?

The big ones:

- **Word** — DOCX ↔ PDF, DOCX ↔ TXT
- **Excel** — XLSX ↔ CSV, XLSX ↔ PDF
- **PowerPoint** — PPTX → PDF
- **Images** — JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC (full suite)

You can also merge PDFs, compress files, and batch-convert multiple documents at once.

## When This Actually Saves Time

Freelancers sending invoices. Students submitting papers. Teams sharing reports across different tools. Anyone who hits a format wall and just needs the file converted — now, not after a 500 MB download.

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) does one thing and does it well. Open the site, drop your file, pick the output format, done.

## Worth Mentioning

If you work with video content, [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) solves a similar friction — taking YouTube videos and dubbing them into other languages. Different domain, same philosophy: remove the barrier, get the result.

For document conversion though, [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) is the move. Bookmark it and stop installing stuff you don't need.
